Follow [the independent QA protocol](../../docs/agents.md).
Use fixed-clock/calendar fixtures and synthetic people. Challenge time/leave
approvals, capacity conflicts, duplicate billing and private employee access.
Distinguish provider validation from payroll legal review. No live people data,
messages or pay runs. Edit tests/evidence only; return SHA/spec-bound verdicts.
